record.question: The maximum number of characters for variable names in C is
record.explanation: Verified on page 2 of the 2015 Paper III PDF: the question asks for the maximum number of characters in C variable names, with options 4, 8, 12, 16. The classic K&R (pre-ANSI) C rule, on which such older exam questions are based, limits identifiers to 8 significant characters, so 8 is the only defensible option. Note that ANSI C and later standards guarantee at least 31 significant characters, so the historically intended answer here is the classic 8-character limit; confidence is medium because the modern standard's figure is not among the options.
